title: Weighted approximate tangent spaces from unweighted ones on closed subsets (Simon Remark 3.1.8(1))
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}, A a Borel set with Hⁿ(A) < ∞, and ϑ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ Borel measurable and Hⁿ-integrable on A. Suppose that for every closed set K ⊆ A, Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ K has an approximate tangent space of K (Simon Def. 3.1.4; Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n K x P for some P). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ A there is a subspace P that is the approximate tangent space of A at x with respect to ϑ (Simon Def. 3.1.7; Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A ϑ x P).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ϑ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ∞ → Measurable ϑ → IntegrableOn ϑ A (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) → (∀ K : Set (Amb n ℓ), IsClosed K → K ⊆ A → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)), x ∈ K → ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n K x P) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)), x ∈ A → ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A ϑ x P
